participant.title: Practice: internal test server
participant.scenario: This practice task is not scored. Use it to get to know the form before the real tasks start. You are creating a small server that the team uses for internal testing.

requirements.text: Add an inbound rule that allows TCP port 8080 from the internal network 10.0.0.0/16.
Submit the form when you are done.

participant.notes: There are no wrong answers in this practice task.

display.title: Practice: a test server
display.scenario: This practice task is not scored. Use it to get to know the form before the real tasks start. You are setting up a small server, a computer that a team uses for testing.

requirements.text: Change the server's name to practice-server.
Choose the server size with 2 processors and 2 GB of memory (t3.small).
Add a row for the team's network: choose "Other", type the service number 8080, keep "Only this address" and type 10.0.0.0/16.
Submit the form when you are done.

display.notes: There are no wrong answers in this practice task.

design.notes: The practice task only asks for neutral changes (name, size, one internal rule), so it teaches the controls without pointing at any security setting. Its starting values are all secure; this is the same for both conditions.
